name: Set Columns
description: Define a sheet's columns once — header text, the record field each column shows, and a width — so Add Rows can take records as they are and the header row is written for you. columns is a list of { header, key, width }.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet) || workbook.addWorksheet(sheet || 'Sheet1'); ws.columns = (Array.isArray(columns) ? columns : []).map((c) => ({ header: String(c.header ?? c.key ?? c.field ?? ''), key: String(c.key ?? c.field ?? c.header ?? ''), ...(c.width ? { width: +c.width } : {}) })); return workbook; })() }}"}]
